title: QID-gap recheck v1 — the remaining compound-label upstream gaps
description: Periodic live re-resolution of the QID-less compound-label subfields held in foundry/held.json (resolver-v4 queue bucket, recheck-wave2-v1). Each is recorded upstream_gap in scripts/foundry/wikidata-goldenset.json with per-seed QC rejection rulings (sessions #9/#10/#11/#21) and was live re-confirmed as an honest gap by decision (92) (session #50, 2026-07-02). Resolver v4 (singular fallback + compound decomposition + orphan-stub penalty) has existed since 2026-06-11 — this manifest is NOT a resolver capability test; it measures whether Wikidata has since grown a usable upstream discipline entity. Triage rule: compare every selection against the goldenset must_not_select lists and the session-#11 umbrella test (a component anchor is acceptable only when the component term umbrellas the combined community) before treating any hit as new. Seed list trimmed 2026-07-29 (session #60): five of the original eight had been promoted since — computer-systems, databases-and-information-systems and distributed-and-parallel-computing on ACM CCS anchors, sensation-and-perception on APA PsycInfo 2320 and naval-architecture-and-marine-engineering on NCES CIP 14.2201, all under node-policy v1.4 (decision (102)). Leaving them in overstated the gap and re-resolved already-answered labels on every run.

include: Re-resolution ONLY of the held QID-less compound-label subfields still at `proposed` in /data; no new nodes, no new proposals
Any newly-appeared upstream entity must pass multi-signal verification (P31 discipline-kind, sitelinks, enwiki) — never label-match alone
exclude: Everything else in /data and the held ledger
Node-shape changes (splitting compound nodes is a §12 ruling, not a resolver outcome)

allowed_public_sources.notes: CC0. Known traps per goldenset: Q105981125 (0-sitelink orphan stub) and Q428691 (computer engineering — separate field) for computer-systems; Q180634 (distributed computing) fails the umbrella test for the combined node; Q64812807 (information systems studies) does not cover databases; Q160402 (perception, process concept) and Q500096 (psychophysics, narrower) rejected for sensation-and-perception; Q4874465 (Bayesian cognitive science, narrow) and Q96319640 (journal) rejected for computational-cognitive-science; Q1331926 (decision making, process) and Q15746672 (journal) rejected for JDM; Q3281534 (modern period, era not discipline) for modern-history; Q101910631 (0-sitelink combined stub) for naval-architecture.

forbidden_sources.reason: External links only; never primary evidence (charter hard constraint).
No cloud LLM API calls in repo tooling (charter hard constraint).
No scraping or crawling of third-party sites (charter hard constraint).

notes: Recheck manifest — resolver measurement only; produces a source pack, never proposals.
If a seed newly resolves clean (multi-signal, not in must_not_select), the verdict is a NEW goldenset entry + a node-promotion-v1 candidate via the standard decision-file flow.
If every seed remains a gap, the honest unblock paths are (a) periodic upstream recheck and (b) node-promotion v1.4 alternative-anchor taxonomy extension (decision (93) — CPO gate).

Measurement 2026-07-29 (session #60): 3/3 still gaps, every selection a known must_not_select referent — computational-cognitive-science → Bayesian cognitive science (narrower, score 40), judgment-and-decision-making → decision making (the process, not the discipline), modern-history → modern period (the era). Zero new upstream entities. Note that a v1.4 clause-1 taxonomy path is separately closed for the first two by strict name-identity (§12 clause 3): no ratified authority maintains a category under either name — APA PsycInfo was swept in full for JDM in 2026-07-02 and CIP names Cognitive Science, not Computational Cognitive Science. These are stable, versioned taxonomies, so re-sweeping them on a short cycle measures nothing; the upstream-Wikidata recheck is the live signal.
